turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My partner and I are buying our first proper coffee machine together, and we can't agree.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get through all the options before you weigh in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He wants a manual espresso machine with a steam wand, a bit fiddly but very satisfying.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'd prefer a bean to cup machine that grinds and brews with one button.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's also a filter machine with a timer, so coffee's ready when the alarm goes off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we keep our cheap French press and spend the money on really good beans.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It depends on your mornings. If you're rushed, the bean to cup or the timed filter make life easy. The manual machine suits a hobbyist, and honestly, great beans in your French press might surprise you both.
